name: cfcmt-bus-value-diagnostic-v1
target_row_selection: All existing 2048 stop and 2048 calibrate rows; same rows at every checkpoint stage. No final test rows.
physical_model_comparison: Recorded actions only, positive-dt nonterminal rows with state.time/horizon<0.75; matched future-action RNG and identical decoded model transitions across stages.
source_row_selection: 256 uniformly spaced positions from the already consumed 16384-row source pool, including both endpoints, plus every existing source terminal tail for a separate terminal-anchor diagnostic. No new source outcomes.
missing_artifact: Final policy artifacts contain actor only. Final same-state Q/V are unavailable; last logged final minibatches remain separate observations.
action_semantics: Deterministic proposed holding before the physical completion executor; actor-zero Q gaps are learned preferences, not measured action gains.
value_metrics: Recorded-action Q, zero-action Q, actor-action Q, value V, positive-Q fractions, exact masked IQL residual; actual versus model one-step H2O+ target under matched RNG.
model_metrics: Predicted versus actual duration and reward on observed actions; next-state bootstrap differences. No fitted trust or model updates.
decisions: Locate pre-existing source value error, category-reset shift, target adaptation change and model next-state bias before specifying another experiment; never select a tested checkpoint or retune the pilot.
interpretation: Read-only diagnostic using held-out behavior transitions; it does not identify the counterfactual cost of a new actor action or a final critic that was not saved.
